blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.
blocks.zh: 技能强化剂通过将成功的轨迹蒸馏成可重复使用的策略,提高样本效率. 然而,大多数现有方法仍然以文字为中心,将空间布局和动作状态对应线化,变成失去几何结构的语言。 最近的努力已开始纳入视觉证据,但将技能建设和更新与政策优化分开,使相互改进的情况没有得到充分利用。 我们提出ViSkill,这是一个视觉-内在技能学习框架,将成功的交互编码为VLM代理直接访问的复合视觉技能卡. 获取的技能指导推论和奖励塑造,而成功的轨迹则被提炼回图书馆,形成闭塞的反馈循环,其中技能积累和政策改进相互加强. 可选的冷启动机制进一步加快了早期学习. 通过对Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill的评价,ViSkill取得了0.89的总体成功率,通过冷启动初始化,上升至0.91,比所有评估的专有和开源基线都好,同时比标准的PPO更快聚合。 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill上找到.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Text-centric skills linearize spatial experience into language, causing lossy abstraction. ViSkill instead represents reusable experience as visual skill cards that preserve spatial structure natively.
blocks.zh: 图1:以文字为中心的技能将空间经验线性地化为语言,引起失落的抽象. 而ViSkill则代表了作为视觉技能卡的可再用体验,在本土上保留了空间结构.

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Ahmadian et al., 2024 ) has become a central paradigm for training Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents that interact with complex, multi-turn environments ( Zhai et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Under standard RL, successful strategies are absorbed only implicitly into policy parameters, requiring the agent to rediscover similar spatial solutions across episodes ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Dong et al., 2026 ) . Yet successful trajectories already encode reusable procedural knowledge, such as how to navigate around obstacles or how to coordinate multi-step object manipulations, that could directly benefit future tasks. This motivates a natural complement to parameter-based learning: explicitly retaining and reusing successful experience across episodes.
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL)(Schulman等,2017;Guo等,2025;Ahmadian等,2024;)已成为培养与复杂多回合环境相互作用的Visual-Langage Model(VLM)代理商的中心范例(Zhai等,2024;Wang等,2026a.). 根据标准RL,成功的策略只被隐含地吸收到政策参数中,要求代理人重新发现各起事件的类似空间解决方案(Feng等,2026;Wang等,2026c; 董等, 2026 (中文(简体) ). 然而,成功的轨迹已经编码了可重复使用的程序知识,例如如何绕过障碍或如何协调多步物体操纵,这可以直接有利于未来的任务。 这激励了对基于参数的学习的一种自然补充:明确保留和重新利用不同阶段的成功经验。

blocks.en: Skill-augmented agents realize this by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies and retrieving them for future tasks ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and have shown consistent gains in both sample efficiency and task performance. However, two fundamental gaps limit their effectiveness in visually grounded environments, where, unlike text-based settings, the agent must interpret spatial layouts, track object relationships, and reason about how actions induce visual state transitions ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhai et al., 2024 ) . The first is a representation gap : existing skills are predominantly text-centric ( Ni et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , linearizing spatial layouts, relative positions, and action–state correspondences into language, which risks losing geometric information critical for strategy execution, as shown in Figure 1 . The second is a learning gap : although recent work has begun incorporating visual evidence into skill construction and utilization ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , these approaches typically decouple skill construction from policy optimization, leaving the bidirectional interplay between visual skill acquisition and policy learning largely underexplored.
blocks.zh: 技能强化剂通过将成功的轨迹分馏入可再用策略并取回来完成未来的任务来意识到这一点(王等等,2023;赵等,2024;夏等,2026;史等,2026;张等,2026b),并在样本效率和任务性能上表现出了一致的提高. 然而,两个根本的空白限制了它们在视网膜环境中的有效性,与基于文本的设置不同,代理商必须解释空间布局,跟踪对象关系,以及行动如何诱导视态过渡的理由(Yang等,2025;Zhai等,2024.). 第一个是代表性差距:现有技能主要是以文字为中心的(Ni等,2026;Yang等,2026;Lin等,2026),将空间布局线性化,相对位置,以及动作将对应语言化,这有可能丢失对战略执行至关重要的几何信息,如图一所示。 第二是学习差距:虽然最近的工作已经开始将视觉证据纳入技能建设和利用(张等,2026a; Jiang等人,2026;Liu等人,2026;Wang等人,2026b.),这些方法一般将技能构建与政策优化脱钩,使得视觉技能获取与政策学习的双向相互作用基本未得到充分探讨.

blocks.en: We introduce ViSkill , a visual-native skill learning framework that couples reusable visual experience with reinforcement optimization for VLM agents. Each skill is stored as a composite visual skill card that renders annotated trajectory frames alongside a policy-distilled strategy description into a unified image, directly preserving the spatial and procedural context of successful experience. Given the current task state, ViSkill retrieves skills by matching geometric configurations and injects the full skill card into the VLM’s visual context. The retrieved skill further provides a skill-guided reward that assigns partial credit to failed trajectories that show skill-relevant progress. After each episode, successful trajectories that pass quality and novelty gates are distilled back into the library as new visual skills. To bootstrap this loop, a cold-start mechanism optionally pre-populates the library with a small set of diverse, solver-derived seed skills. Together, these mechanisms form a closed feedback loop: retrieved skills improve the policy through in-context demonstration and reward shaping, while the improved policy contributes higher-quality skills back to the library.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ViSkill, 一种视觉-内在技能学习框架, 夫妇可以重复视觉体验, 每种技能都作为综合视觉技能卡储存,使附加说明的轨迹框架与政策简化战略描述一起成为统一的图像,直接保留成功经验的空间和程序背景。 鉴于当前的任务状态,ViSkill通过匹配几何配置来取回技能,并给VLM的视觉上下文注入完整的技能卡. 收回的技能进一步提供技能指导奖励,对显示技能相关进展的失败轨迹给予部分赞扬。 每集后,通过质量和新颖门的成功轨迹被分馏回图书馆作为新的视觉技能. 要拖住这个循环,一个冷启动机制可选地预发了库,拥有少量多样的,解析器衍生的种子技能. 这些机制共同组成了封闭的反馈循环:检索的技能通过内文演示和奖励塑造来改进政策,而改进后的政策则为图书馆提供了更高质量的技能.

blocks.en: We evaluate ViSkill on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, spanning discrete 2D spatial planning and coordinate-grounded 3D manipulation. ViSkill outperforms all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines with an overall success rate of 0.89 0.89 , rising to 0.91 0.91 with cold-start initialization. Beyond final performance, ViSkill converges faster and achieves higher success rates throughout training, reflecting the positive feedback loop between skill accumulation and policy improvement. Ablations further confirm that visual skill representations consistently outperform text-centric alternatives, and that skills distilled under joint policy optimization transfer more effectively than those accumulated without it.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上的ViSkill,它们跨越了离散的2D空间规划和协调的3D操纵。 ViSkill业绩高于所有经评价的专有和开源基线,总体成功率为0.89 0.89,在冷启动后上升到0.91 0.91。 除了最后业绩外,ViSkill更快地汇合起来,在整个培训中取得更高的成功率,反映了技能积累与政策改进之间的积极反馈循环. 差距进一步证实,视觉技能表现一直优于以文字为中心的替代办法,在联合政策优化下,技能的转让比没有这种技能的转让更有效。

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的贡献有三:

blocks.en: • We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that represents reusable procedural experience as composite visual skill cards, preserving spatial and procedural context in a form directly accessible to VLM agents. • We develop geometry-aware skill retrieval and a skill-guided reinforcement objective that form a closed feedback loop, where retrieved skills guide policy optimization and successful trajectories are distilled back into the library. • We empirically demonstrate across 2D spatial planning and 3D manipulation that ViSkill outperforms proprietary and open-source baselines, converging faster and achieving higher final success rates than standard PPO.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们提议采用ViSkill这一视觉内在技能学习框架,它代表可重复使用的程序经验,作为复合视觉技能卡,以VLM代理商可直接使用的形式保留空间和程序背景。 我们开发出几何知识技能检索和由技能指导的强化目标,形成闭塞反馈循环,其中检索的技能指导政策优化和成功的轨迹被分解回库. —— 我们通过2D空间规划和3D操纵的经验证明,ViSkill的性能超过了专有性和开源基线,比标准的PPO更快地趋同并取得更高的最终成功率.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Reinforcement Learning for VLM Agents
blocks.zh: 2.1 强化VLM代理的学习

blocks.en: Recent work has extended reinforcement learning from language-model alignment to vision-language reasoning, using verifiable rewards to improve visual perception and reasoning ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Beyond single-turn prediction, several studies formulate VLMs as sequential decision-making agents and optimize them through interaction with visual environments ( Zhai et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , addressing challenges such as long-horizon credit assignment and sparse reward in visually grounded tasks ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) . However, interaction experience is typically consumed as transient rollout data and absorbed implicitly into policy parameters. Rather than treating experience solely as a training signal, ViSkill externalizes successful trajectories into an explicit library of retrievable visual-native skills, allowing accumulated experience to guide future inference and provide dense rewards that facilitate policy optimization.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作将强化学习从语言模式调整扩大到视觉语言推理,利用可核查的奖励改善视觉感知和推理(刘等,2025a; 沈等,2025;李等,2026a;黄等,2026a;李等,2026b. 除了单回合预测外,有几项研究将VLM作为相继决策代理人,并通过与视觉环境的互动来优化它们(Zhai等,2024;Liu等,2025b;Zheng等,2026;Wang等,2026a),解决视网膜信用分配和视网膜任务中鲜有奖励等难题(Wang等,2025;Feng等,2026c.). 然而,互动经验通常被作为瞬时推出的数据来使用,并被隐入政策参数。 ViSkill将成功轨迹外部化,形成一个可检索的可视-内在技能的明确库,使所积累的经验能够指导未来的推论,并提供密集的奖励,促进政策优化。

blocks.en: 2.2 Skill-Augmented Agents
blocks.zh: 2.2 技术鉴定人

blocks.en: Skills provide a modular mechanism for transferring procedural knowledge across episodes. Most existing approaches distill interaction trajectories into natural-language instructions or structured workflows organized into persistent libraries for retrieval and reuse ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , with recent work further incorporating such libraries into reinforcement learning ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action–state correspondences that are central to visually grounded decision making. Recent methods have begun incorporating visual information into skill construction and memory ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . AtlasVA ( Wang et al., 2026b ) further evolves spatial atlases from interaction statistics for dense reward shaping. Within this broader direction, ViSkill represents reusable procedures as composite visual skill cards and couples their online distillation with policy optimization.
blocks.zh: 技能提供了一种模块化机制,用于在各种情况下转让程序知识。 多数现有方法将互动轨迹分馏入自然语言指令或结构化工作流程,组织入持久性图书馆进行检索和再利用(Shinn等,2023;Zhao等,2024;Wang等,2023),近期工作进一步将此类图书馆纳入强化学习(Xia等,2026;Shi等,2026;Lu等,2026). 然而,这些方法仍然以文字为中心,线性化的空间布局和行动----说明对视线决策至关重要的对应关系。 最近的方法已经开始将视觉信息纳入技能建设和记忆(Jiang等,2026;Zhang等,2026a; Huang et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026). AtlasVA (Wang et al., 2026b) 从相互作用统计中进一步演化出空间地图集,以形成密集的奖励. 在这一大方向上,ViSkill代表可重复使用的程序,作为复合视觉技能卡,并结合政策优化在线提炼。

blocks.en: When starting from an empty library, early-stage exploration lacks skill guidance, delaying the positive feedback loop between skill distillation and policy learning. To address this cold-start problem, ViSkill optionally pre-populates the library with a diverse set of seed skills before training begins. Candidate trajectories are generated using offline task-specific solvers with strategy descriptions distilled by an external model, and selected through farthest-point sampling in the geometric feature space to maximize initial coverage. These seed skills serve only as an initialization: once training begins, all subsequent skills are distilled entirely by the policy from its own successful trajectories. The cold-start library size is set to N cold = ⌊ γ ​ N conv ⌋ N_{\mathrm{cold}}=\lfloor\gamma N_{\mathrm{conv}}\rfloor , where γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1] is the cold-start ratio and N conv N_{\mathrm{conv}} is the converged library size from a preliminary run without cold-start initialization; setting γ = 0 \gamma=0 disables external-model initialization, providing a flexible trade-off between early-stage sample efficiency and independence from external-model supervision.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate ViSkill on three visually grounded interactive environments spanning 2D spatial reasoning and 3D embodied manipulation, adopted from VAGEN ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Sokoban requires the agent to push all boxes onto target locations; FrozenLake requires it to navigate to a goal while avoiding holes. Both environments provide grid-based visual observations and discrete directional actions. PrimitiveSkill evaluates coordinate-grounded manipulation in third-person 3D scenes, comprising the Place, Stack, Drawer, and Align tasks from VAGEN and the Swap task introduced by AtlasVA ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . We report success rate across all environments.
blocks.zh: 我们从VAGEN(Wang等人,2026年a)获得三个视觉基础互动环境的ViSkill的评价,这些环境涵盖2D空间推理和3D内含操纵。 。 。 。 。 Sokoban要求代理将所有箱子推入目标位置;FrozenLake要求它导航到一个入球同时避免出洞. 这两种环境都提供基于网格的视觉观测和离散的方向动作. PrimitiveSkill在第三人称3D场景中评价了坐标基操纵,由来自VAGEN的Place,Stack, Drawer,和Align等任务以及AtlasVA引入的Swap任务(Wang等,2026b.)组成. 我们报告所有环境的成功率。

blocks.en: We compare ViSkill against representative proprietary and open-source VLMs. Proprietary baselines include frontier models from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic ( OpenAI, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2025b ; Hurst et al., 2024 ; Google, 2025 ; Google, 2024 ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Anthropic, 2025a ) . For open-source models, we evaluate the Qwen2.5-VL family at 3B, 7B, and 72B scales ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , along with three reinforcement-learning-enhanced 3B baselines. VLM-R1 applies R1-style reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards to enhance general visual reasoning ( Shen et al., 2025 ) . VAGEN trains multi-turn VLM agents by explicitly reinforcing world-model reasoning ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . AtlasVA ( Wang et al., 2026b ) is a memory-augmented RL baseline that evolves danger and affinity heatmaps from interaction statistics and uses them for dense spatial reward shaping. For a controlled comparison, VAGEN, AtlasVA, and ViSkill share the same Qwen2.5-VL-3B backbone and environment seeds. ViSkill follows the training horizon of VAGEN, which is shorter than that of AtlasVA.
blocks.zh: 我们比较ViSkill与代表性专有和开源的VLM. 专有基线包括来自OpenAI、Google和Anthropic的前沿模型(OpenAI,2025a;OpenAI,2025b;Hurst等,2024;Google,2025;Google,2024;Anthropic,2025b;Anthropic,2025a)。 对于开源模型,我们以3B,7B,72B等尺度(Bai等,2025年)来评价Quen2.5-VL家族,同时评估三个增强学习-增强的3B基线. VLM-R1应用了R1风格的强化学习并有基于规则的奖励来增强一般视觉推理(沈等,2025. VAGEN通过明确强化世界模型推理(Wang等,2026a)来训练多转VLM剂. AtlasVA(Wang等,2026b)是一个内存增强的RL基线,从相互作用统计中演化出危险和亲和热图,并用于密集的空间奖励塑造. 为了进行可控比较,VAGEN,阿特拉斯VA,和ViSkill共享相同的Quen2.5-VL-3B骨干和环境种子. ViSkill跟随VAGEN的训练地平线,它比AtlasVA短.

blocks.en: We use Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct as the policy backbone, following the PPO configuration of VAGEN ( Wang et al., 2026a ) with a rollout batch size of 128, a PPO mini-batch size of 32, and actor and critic learning rates of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . Sokoban and FrozenLake are trained for 300 steps on 4 × 4\times H100 GPUs; PrimitiveSkill is trained jointly for 60 steps on 2 × 2\times H100 GPUs with an additional H100 GPU dedicated to the ManiSkill ( Mu et al., 2021 ) environment server. We set the similarity weight α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9 , EMA coefficient β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , skill-guidance weight λ = 0.8 \lambda=0.8 , novelty threshold δ d = 0.9 \delta_{d}=0.9 , retrieval threshold δ r = 0.8 \delta_{r}=0.8 , and cold-start ratio γ = 0.2 \gamma=0.2 , with GPT-5.4-mini ( OpenAI, 2026 ) serving as the external model for cold-start strategy distillation.

blocks.en: Table 3 ablates the three core components of ViSkill. Removing Skill-Guided Reward leads to moderate performance drops ( − 0.05 -0.05 on Sokoban, − 0.04 -0.04 on FrozenLake), indicating that the skill-derived reward signal provides a useful but not dominant training contribution. Removing Strategy causes a larger drop on Sokoban ( − 0.10 -0.10 ), suggesting that high-level strategic guidance is particularly beneficial for combinatorial planning tasks. Removing Optimization yields largest degradation ( − 0.53 -0.53 on Sokoban, − 0.51 -0.51 on FrozenLake), where skill retrieval and distillation are retained but model training is disabled. This highlights the importance of the co-evolution between policy optimization and skill learning: training enables the model to better leverage retrieved skills, while an improving policy in turn contributes higher-quality skills to the library, creating a mutually reinforcing cycle that is essential for effective learning.
blocks.zh: 表3列出了Viskill的三个核心组成部分。 取消技能指导奖励导致中度性能下降(Sokoban为0.05-0.05;FrozenLake为0.04-0.04),表明技能奖励信号提供了有益但并非占主导地位的培训贡献。 取消战略导致Sokoban的下降幅度更大(-0.10-0.10),这表明高级别战略指导对组合规划任务特别有益。 消除优化产生最大的退化(Sokoban上的−0.53-0.53;FrozenLake上的−0.51-0.51),保留技能检索和蒸馏,但模式培训被禁用。 这突出说明了政策优化与技能学习之间的共同演变的重要性:培训使模式能够更好地利用检索的技能,而改进政策反过来又为图书馆提供更高质量的技能,创造一个相辅相成的周期,这对有效学习至关重要。

blocks.en: Figure 8 examines whether the skill library accumulated during training can transfer to the unoptimized base model. We compare two libraries: one distilled with joint policy optimization and one without. Augmenting the base model with either library yields consistent gains over the no-skill baseline, confirming that evolved skills are reusable beyond the trained policy. Skills accumulated with joint policy optimization further improve success rate to 0.41 0.41 on Sokoban and 0.39 0.39 on FrozenLake, outperforming those distilled without optimization. This demonstrates that the co-evolution of policy and skill library produces higher-quality skills: an improving policy generates more successful and diverse trajectories and strategies, which in turn enrich the library with more effective and transferable skills.
blocks.zh: 图8审查了在培训期间积累的技能库是否可以转移到未优化的基础模式。 我们比较两个图书馆:一个与联合政策优化相提并论,一个与无。 以图书馆或图书馆为基础模式的增强,在无技能基线的基础上产生持续收益,证实演化后的技能在训练有素的政策之外可以再用。 通过联合政策优化而积累的技能进一步提高了索克班0.410.41和冰冻湖0.390.39的成功率,超过了未经优化而提炼出的技能。 这表明政策和技能图书馆的共同演变产生了更高质量的技能:改进后的政策产生了更成功和多样化的轨迹和战略,反过来又以更有效和可转让的技能丰富了图书馆。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that represents reusable procedural experience as composite visual skill cards and couples skill retrieval with reinforcement optimization through a closed feedback loop. By preserving spatial and geometric structure in a form directly accessible to VLM agents, ViSkill addresses the representation gap of text-centric skill approaches, while skill-guided rewards and online distillation enable policy improvement and skill accumulation to co-evolve. Experiments on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill demonstrate consistent gains over proprietary and open-source baselines, and ablations confirm that visual representations, strategic guidance, and joint optimization each contribute to the positive feedback loop.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍ViSkill是一个视觉-内在技能学习框架,它代表可重复使用的程序经验,作为复合视觉技能卡和夫妇技能检索,并通过闭合反馈循环进行强化优化. 通过保留空间和几何结构,使其直接为VLM代理商所利用,ViSkill解决了以文字为中心的技能方法在代表性方面的差距,而由技能指导的奖励和在线提炼则能够使政策改进和技能积累共同演变。 在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上的实验显示,相对于专有和开源基线而言,收益是始终如一的,模拟证实视觉表达、战略指导和联合优化都有助于积极的反馈循环。

blocks.en: ViSkill is currently evaluated on environments supported by the VAGEN framework; whether visual skill cards provide consistent benefits in more complex or open-ended settings remains to be validated. The skill-guided reward further assumes that useful partial progress reaches states represented by the retrieved skill, which may provide limited guidance when valid solutions traverse disjoint state paths.
blocks.zh: ViSkill目前接受对VAGEN框架所支持环境的评价;视觉技能卡在更复杂或开放的环境下是否提供一致的好处仍有待验证. 以技能指导的奖励还假定,以检索技能为代表的有益部分进展会到达各州,当有效解决方案穿越不相连的州道时,这种技能可能提供有限的指导。

blocks.en: Each library entry stores the composite card, geometric descriptor, reference action trajectory, strategy description, utility, and usage count. The reference trajectory is retained for computing the skill-guidance reward; the composite card is appended to the VLM’s visual context at decision time. Newly distilled skills are initialized with utility 0.5 0.5 and usage count 0 0 ; cold-start skills use the same initialization and are subsequently managed identically to online-distilled skills.
blocks.zh: 每个库条目都存储了复合卡,几何描述符,参考动作轨迹,策略描述,用途和用法计数. 参考轨迹保留用于计算技能指导奖励;复合卡附在决定时间的VLM视觉上下文后. 新提炼出的技能被初始化,使用功用为0.5 0.5,使用功用为0;冷起动技能使用相同的初始化,随后得到与在线消化技能相同的管理.

blocks.en: Only the skill retrieved for an episode receives a utility and usage-count update after termination; all non-retrieved skills retain their current statistics. When the library reaches capacity, we apply the utility–frequency eviction rule before admitting the new skill, so that infrequently used or ineffective skills are gradually displaced by more recent acquisitions.
blocks.zh: 只有为一集检索的技能在终止后获得实用性和使用量的更新;所有未检索的技能保留其目前的统计数据。 当图书馆达到容量时,我们在接受新技能之前适用实用性-频率驱逐规则,以便不经常使用或不有效的技能逐渐被最近获得的人才所取代。

blocks.en: The environment reward is accumulated over interaction turns before the skill-guidance term is added. In Sokoban, each turn with a non-empty valid action sequence receives a formatting reward of 0.1 0.1 , and task completion receives a terminal reward of 1.0 1.0 . FrozenLake uses the same terminal reward with a formatting reward of 0.02 0.02 . In PrimitiveSkill, each valid turn receives a formatting reward of 0.1 0.1 , each newly completed manipulation stage (e.g., grasping, placing, or aligning an object) provides an incremental reward of 2.0 2.0 , and full task completion adds a terminal reward of 1.0 1.0 .
blocks.zh: 在增加技能指导术语之前,通过互动转弯积累环境奖励。 在Sokoban中,每个转弯带有非空有效动作序列,可得到0.10.1的格式奖励,任务完成可得到1.01.0的终端奖励. 冻结 Lake使用相同的终端奖励,格式奖励为0.02 0.02. 在"先入为主"(PrimitiveSkill)中,每个有效转会获得0.1 0.1的格式奖励,每个新完成的操纵阶段(如抓取,放置,或对齐一个对象)提供2.0 2.0的递增奖励,完整任务完成后会增加1.0 1.0的终端奖励.

blocks.en: We instantiate ℓ \ell using task-specific state progress rather than exact action alignment. In Sokoban and FrozenLake, progress is measured by relative position with respect to the initial state: the player–box configuration for Sokoban and the agent position for FrozenLake. In PrimitiveSkill, progress is determined by matching completed actions against the reference trajectory. In each case, ℓ \ell is the furthest matching progress point along the retrieved skill trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们使用特定任务状态的进度来进行即时分析,而不是精确的动作调整。 在"Sokoban"和"FrozenLake"中,进展由相对于初始状态的相对位置来衡量:玩家-box配置为"Sokoban",代理配置为"FrozenLake". 在PrimitiveSkill中,进展是通过将已完成的行动与参考轨迹相匹配来确定的. 在每种情况下, I\ell 都是在检索的技能轨迹上最相匹配的进度点 。

blocks.zh: 附录B 训练和评价详情

blocks.en: B.1 Environment and Task Configurations
blocks.zh: B.1 环境和任务配置

blocks.en: All tasks provide the policy with RGB observations together with a textual task instruction and action-format specification; no symbolic state is exposed to the policy. Each episode is generated deterministically from its random seed, and success is evaluated by the task-specific environment predicate. Training and evaluation use disjoint seed ranges across all environments, ensuring that evaluation layouts and object configurations are never seen during training.
blocks.zh: 所有任务都向政策提供RGB观察以及文字任务指示和动作格式规格;没有象征性的状态接触到政策. 每集由随机出种产生决定性,成功与否由任务特定环境的上游来评价. 培训和评价在所有环境中使用脱节种子范围,确保培训期间从未看到评价布局和对象配置。

blocks.en: At each turn, the policy outputs up to three actions from { up , down , left , right }. An episode lasts at most five turns and succeeds when the box reaches its target.
blocks.zh: 每个回合,政策产出最多为从{上,下,左,右}三个行动。 剧集最多会持续5个转弯,并在盒子达到目标后成功.

blocks.en: We use randomly generated maps with frozen-cell probability 0.8 0.8 . Transitions are deterministic, with slippery dynamics disabled. The policy selects from { up , down , left , right } and may output up to five actions per turn over at most five turns. An episode terminates when the agent reaches the goal or falls into a hole.
blocks.zh: 我们使用随机生成的地图 带有冻细胞概率0.8 0.8. 过渡是决定性的,滑动的动态是无法控制的。 策略从 {上,下,左,右} 中选择,最多每转出五个动作 。 插曲在经纪人到达目标或掉入洞后终止.

blocks.en: We use third-person RGB observations from ManiSkill ( Mu et al., 2021 ) across five tasks: Place, Stack, Drawer, Align, and Swap. The policy controls a Franka Panda arm via parameterized actions from { pick ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) , place ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) , push ( x 1 , y 1 , z 1 , x 2 , y 2 , z 2 ) (x_{1},y_{1},z_{1},x_{2},y_{2},z_{2}) } with continuous x ​ y ​ z xyz coordinates. The policy may issue up to two actions per turn, with a maximum of three turns for Place, Stack, Drawer, and Align, and four for Swap.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ManiSkill(Mu等,2021年)的第三人称RGB观测数据,涉及五个任务:Place, Stack, Drawer, Align,和Swap. 政策通过参数化动作控制了一只Franka熊猫臂从{ pick (x, y, z) (x, y, z), place (x, y, z) (x, y, z), 推 (x 1, y 1, z 1, y 2, z 2) (x_{ 1}, y_{ 1}, z_{ 1} (x_{ 2}, y_{ 2})} 有连续的x y z xyz 坐标. 政策每个回合最多可发出两个动作,Place、Stack、Drawer和Align最多可发出三个动作,交换最多可发出四个动作。

blocks.zh: B.2 训练超参数

blocks.en: Our implementation builds on VAGEN ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , which is developed on top of the veRL framework ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) . We share a common optimization and rollout configuration across all three environments, adapting only the training horizon, computational resources, and sequence-length limits to each task. Tables 5 and 6 summarize the shared and environment-specific hyperparameters, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们的实施工作以VAGEN(Wang等,2026a)为基础,它是在veRL框架之上制定的(Sheng等,2025年)。 我们在所有三个环境中都有一个共同的优化和推出配置,仅调整培训视野、计算资源以及每项任务的序列长度限制。 表5和表6分别汇总了共享参数和环境特有的超参数。

blocks.en: PrimitiveSkill System Prompt Template You are an AI assistant controlling a Franka Emika robot arm. Your goal is to understand human instructions and translate them into a sequence of executable actions for the robot, based on visual input and the instruction. Action Space Guide You can command the robot using the following actions: 1. pick(x, y, z) # To grasp an object located at position(x,y,z) in the robot’s workspace. 2. place(x, y, z) # To place the object currently held by the robot’s gripper at the target position (x,y,z). 3. push(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2) # To push an object from position (x1,y1,z1) to (x2,y2,z2). Hints: 1. The coordinates (x, y, z) are in millimeters and are all integers. 2. Please ensure that the coordinates are within the workspace limits. 3. The position is the center of the object, when you place, please consider the volume of the object. It’s always fine to set z much higher when placing an item. 4. We will provide the object positions to you, but you need to match them to the object in the image by yourself. You’re facing toward the negative x-axis, and the negative y-axis is to your left, the positive y-axis is to your right, and the positive z-axis is up. blocks.en: D.1 Additional Training Dynamics
blocks.zh: D.1 其他培训动态

blocks.en: Figure 11 disaggregates the average PrimitiveSkill result across its five manipulation tasks. ViSkill consistently reaches full success earlier than PPO on all five tasks. PPO eventually solves Place but plateaus below full success on the remainder, whereas both ViSkill variants achieve a success rate of 1.00 1.00 . Cold-Start further accelerates early-stage learning across tasks. These results confirm that visual skills provide reusable guidance across diverse coordinate-grounded manipulation objectives, rather than improving only the aggregate metric.
blocks.zh: 图11分列了5个操纵任务的平均初级技能结果。 ViSkill在所有五项任务中始终比PPO取得全面成功。 PPO 最终解决 其余部分位于完全成功水平以下,而ViSkill两种变体的成功率为1.00。 冷起进一步加快了跨任务的早期学习. 这些结果证实,视觉技能为各种基于协调的操纵目标提供了可重复使用的指导,而不是仅仅改进总的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Figure 12 illustrates the closed-loop evolution of the skill library. In both environments, the retrieval fraction rises rapidly and stabilizes near one as the library gains coverage, reflecting that existing skills increasingly satisfy the geometric retrieval criterion. Skill admissions, by contrast, concentrate in the early stage and taper off thereafter. This separation confirms that the novelty gate prevents redundant expansion: once common configurations are covered, the agent reuses existing skills while admitting only genuinely novel trajectories.
blocks.zh: 图12显示了技能库的闭路式演变。 在这两种环境中,检索分数迅速上升并随着图书馆的覆盖面增加而稳定在一个附近,这反映出现有技能越来越符合几何检索标准。 相比之下,技术招生则集中在早期阶段,然后就逐渐停止。 这种分离证实了新颖的门能防止冗余扩展:一旦覆盖了常见的配置,代理机会再用已存在的技能,同时只承认真正新颖的轨迹.

blocks.en: Figure 13 compares PPO and ViSkill on matched Sokoban and FrozenLake configurations. blocks.en: In the FrozenLake example, the trajectory stored in the retrieved skill does not exactly match the one executed by ViSkill. The policy takes a different valid route while remaining consistent with the spatial structure and high-level intent of the skill card, indicating that ViSkill uses the card as procedural guidance rather than replaying reference actions.
blocks.zh: 在"FrozenLake"的例子中,存储在被检索技能中的轨迹并不完全匹配由Viskill执行的轨迹. 政策采用不同的有效路线,同时与技能卡的空间结构和高层次意图保持一致,表明ViSkill将卡作为程序指导而不是重放参考动作.

blocks.en: D.3 Quality Threshold Ablation
blocks.zh: D.3 质量阈值

blocks.en: Table 7: Success rates under different quality thresholds.
blocks.zh: 表7:不同质量阈值下的成功率。

blocks.en: Table 7 examines whether ViSkill depends critically on solver-derived quality thresholds by substituting them with a fixed trajectory-length budget. Static-10 achieves success rates of 0.84 0.84 on Sokoban and 0.78 0.78 on FrozenLake, against 0.82 0.82 and 0.84 0.84 for solver-based filtering. The fixed threshold slightly outperforms the solver on Sokoban while incurring only a modest decrease on FrozenLake, indicating that solver access is not a prerequisite for effective quality control. A simple fixed budget therefore provides a practical alternative when task-specific solvers are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 表7审查了ViSkill是否关键地取决于解决者产生的质量阈值,用固定的轨迹长度预算取而代之。 静态-10在索克班上取得了0.84 0.84的成功率和在"冰冻湖"上取得了0.78 0.78的成功率,而在基于溶液的过滤上则取得了0.82 0.82和0.84 0.84的成功率. 固定阈值在Sokoban上略高于解析器,而只在FrozenLake上稍有下降,这表明解析器访问并不是有效质量控制的先决条件. 因此,在缺乏特定任务解决者的情况下,简单的固定预算提供了一个切实可行的替代办法。

blocks.en: D.4 Feature Extractor Ablation
blocks.zh: D.4 特性提取符

blocks.en: Table 8: Success rates with different feature extractors.
blocks.zh: 表8:不同特性提取器的成功率。

blocks.en: Table 8 investigates the role of hand-crafted geometric descriptors by replacing them with DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) visual features for skill retrieval. Despite receiving no task-specific supervision, DINOv2 achieves success rates of 0.80 0.80 on Sokoban and 0.83 0.83 on FrozenLake, falling short of the rule-based extractor by only 0.02 0.02 and 0.01 0.01 in absolute terms. This narrow gap demonstrates that the spatial structure needed for reliable retrieval is largely recoverable from general-purpose visual representations, and that ViSkill is not fundamentally tied to hand-crafted descriptors. Replacing them with learned encoders thus emerges not merely as a future direction but as a practically viable alternative, broadening the applicability of ViSkill to environments where geometric features are difficult to specify manually.
blocks.zh: 表8通过用DINOv2(Oquab等,2023年)视觉特征来取而代之来调查手工几何描述符的作用. 尽管没有接受特定任务的监管,DINOv2在索克班上取得了0.80.0.80分的成功率,在"冰冻湖"上取得了0.83.08分的成功率,在绝对值上低于以规则为基础的提取器只有0.020.02分和0.01分. 这一狭小的差距表明,可靠检索所需的空间结构基本上可以从通用视觉表现中恢复,而且ViSkill与手工制作的描述符没有根本的联系. 因此,用有学识的编码器取而代之不仅是一种未来的方向,而且是一种实际可行的替代办法,将ViSkill的可适用性扩大到几何特征难以人工说明的环境。
